description.value:
Category: Seen Gods

Primarily Practiced in: Zahnheim, North Rodda

Espirian Domains: The Heavens (Valtal, Baythal)

The Protector is the seat of one who is committed to saving those who cannot save themselves. Through duty, determination, and altruism, the Protector is the patron of those who are willing to be the shield and the voice of the downtrodden. Compared to the seat of the Disciplined, the Protector holds firm a commitment to other people and the community rather than a cause.

Galahad was amongst Fellion’s Arsenal, chosen to keep the other members safe even as faith and belief in Fellion waned to the point where she and her arsenal began to fade. Resurging as the eidolon of T’chaiba, Galahad grew in strength over the course of his journey with her until he finally regained his old form and could summon the arsenal and give strength to his former patron deity – which ultimately lead to Fellion’s decision to let her arsenal be free. Galahad appears as a large white-furred loupain that wields a greatsword and shield, donning heavy gold and white armor, though he occasionally appears to bear wings and a more birdlike appearance, due to the connection he shared with his summoner.

Title The Protector

Edicts Champion the defenseless, strike against oppressors, uplift and improve the lives of your community

Anathema Leave an innocent to suffer or trick them into disempowerment

Areas of Concern Protection, Community, Liberation

Religious Symbol A hawk with wings folded around a shield

Sacred Animal Hawk

Sacred Colors white and gold
